chunks: "Indeed, our enemies die by plague, while you die from ailments of the stomach. Verily, it is a sign among you, O assembly of the Shi'ah."

key_terms.أَعْدَاءَنَا: our enemies, referring to the opponents of Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.الشِّيعَةِ: the Shi'ah, the followers and adherents of the Imams عليهم السلام

ai.seo_question: What sign did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام mention regarding the deaths of the Shi'ah and the enemies of Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام contrasts the manner of death of the enemies of Ahl al-Bayt with that of the Shi'ah, describing the latter as dying from abdominal illness. He presents this as a distinguishing sign found among the Shi'ah community.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.578 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Our enemies die of plague, while you (our Shi’ite) die of ailments of the stomach. Verily, this is a sign among you, O’ group of Shi'a."
